title: Build Signal Composer + communication control layer
summary: Create a dual-mode Signal Composer and routing layer for intent/value/action/time/domain tags across email, calendar, chat, browser, mobile, voice, meetings, tasks, CRM, support, and control towers. This is dogfooded internally first, then white-labelled/resold.

thread_parse.purpose: Expose communication intent and route work without relying on memory or manual interpretation.
must_support: Power users who type codes directly
Guided users who select from step-by-step dropdowns
Hybrid users who type and choose interchangeably
Personal, role, team, organisation and portfolio weighting
Cross-tool routing and control tower orchestration

product_modules.name: Signal Composer Widget
product_modules.scope: Inline, stepper, hybrid, autocomplete, command palette and compact chip modes.

product_modules.name: Signal Parser and Validator
product_modules.scope: Parse strings, validate enum values, normalize malformed inputs, return structured signal object.

product_modules.name: AI Signal Classifier
product_modules.scope: Suggest tags from plain language, emails, messages, transcripts and documents.

product_modules.name: Weighting and Preference Engine
product_modules.scope: User, role, team, org and portfolio-level weights; tune what V1/V2/etc means by context.

product_modules.name: Policy and Governance Engine
product_modules.scope: Required fields, escalation rules, mandatory owners/deadlines, audit trail, AGL evidence states.

product_modules.name: Cross-Tool Router
product_modules.scope: Route to email flags, calendar blocks, task queues, CRM updates, support tickets, agents and dashboards.

product_modules.name: Control Tower Dashboard
product_modules.scope: Personal, team, organisation, portfolio and Synapse views of decisions/actions/noise.

product_modules.name: White Label Admin Console
product_modules.scope: Brandable taxonomy, industry packs, customer rules, pricing tier configuration and deployment settings.

surfaces: Browser extension overlay for text boxes
dogfood_test_scenarios: Tag ConsentX launch approval and route to Pen/Gatekeeper
Tag internal strategy thread and create structured build spec
Tag low-value vendor email and suppress
Tag calendar review and auto-create prep task
Capture away-from-keyboard voice action and queue it
Classify an untagged email and suggest the signal
Compare CEO/COO/CFO role weights on same message
Show portfolio control tower roll-up across brands
acceptance_criteria: Parser validates canonical strings and rejects/repairs malformed inputs
Widget supports inline, stepper and hybrid modes
Every signal is stored with org/user/role context and evidence state
Routing worker produces observable queue events and audit logs
Control tower can filter by type/value/action/time/domain/owner/org
White-label taxonomy can be configured per customer/industry
Dogfood scenarios run with receipts and no PRETEND claims

handoff.target: Pen first; promote to Symbio after validation; Synapse only after Gatekeeper evidence.
handoff.autonomy_tier: AUTO for read/inspect/enqueue; LOG for write logs; GATED for deploy/RLS; BLOCKED for payments/IAM/creds/legal.
handoff.next_worker_action: Create implementation bundle: schema.sql, parser.ts, router.ts, composer React widget, seed taxonomy JSON, verification harness, Command Centre widget config.
